title: Saved drives contract
description: Language-neutral saved-drive shapes shared by iOS, Android, backend, and admin. ride mirrors the Firestore `rides/{rideId}` document (docs/firebase-data-model.md). Stats are computed server-side by drives.save from the submitted recording; route GPS data lives only in Cloud Storage under the member-gated rideRoutes/{uid}/{rideId}/ prefix — never in Firestore. No top-speed field exists anywhere. Firestore stores timestamps as native Timestamp values; this contract describes their ISO 8601 JSON serialization.

ride.description: Firestore `rides/{rideId}`. Owner-only read (membership not required — drives saved during a previous membership stay listable); all writes go through drives.save / drives.delete.

distanceMeters.description: Server-computed; null for summary-only saves (no route points).

routePath.description: Canonical Cloud Storage path (rideRoutes/{uid}/{rideId}/route.bin); the file itself is member-gated.

previewImagePath.description: Canonical Cloud Storage path (rideRoutes/{uid}/{rideId}/preview.png); member-gated like the route.

sourceSessionId.description: Client recording identifier used for idempotent save retries.

routePoint.description: A single recorded GPS point submitted to drives.save. Points must be ordered by timestampMs.

saveDriveRequest.description: Input for drives.save (member-only). Distance/duration/average speed are computed server-side; implausible GPS jumps (>200 km/h implied speed) are excluded from distance.

saveDriveResponse.description: Result of drives.save, including the canonical Cloud Storage paths the client uploads the route file and preview image to.

alreadySaved.description: True when an idempotent retry returned the existing drive.

deleteDriveRequest.description: Input for drives.delete (any active owner; membership not required).

rideId.description: Firestore-safe document ID — no path separators.
